item.title: Dumped aggregate., 27th October
item.description:
There has been bags of building sand blocking a parking space on the road for ages. Considering we all have to pay each year to park our cars this is extremely irritating. The building site is at number 6, and they have a garden on the premise so could easily store the aggregate on site. We have spoken to them and they have not moved it. It has been there for months. People on our street have been reporting this and as far as I am aware the council have spoken to the builders but they have not moved it. Sometimes they leave plastic bottles of urine there too. I have asked politely before whether they have a permit and they have said they do not.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Plymouth Road, Plaistow, Greater London
